errors.text_span: demonstriert die prognostizierte Entwicklung der Wasserstoffproduktion und vergleicht verschiedene Produktionsstandorte in Norddeutschland
errors.evidence: This information is derived from the figure's caption, not the chart itself. The chart's visual elements, specifically the title/y-axis label, indicate it shows the 'Änderungsrate in %' (rate of change in %), not hydrogen production directly.
The chart contains five vertical blue bars, not three.

The x-axis labels are abbreviations ('NI', 'MV', etc.). Stating they represent 'Produktionsstandorte' (production sites) is an interpretation based on the figure caption, not information explicitly present in the chart's visual labels.
